body.intent: Fix the usage governor's limits are static (rhiza.daemon.usage.session/weekly or a limit learned from one hit), so they go stale whenever the account's plan or Anthropic's limits change (the owner moved to Max 20x and every limit was wrong); they must be dynamic: read the account's live usage from what Claude Code reports (its status line input carries rate_limits with used_percentage and resets_at per window, e.g. seven_day 49%) or the equivalent API, derive each window's limit and reset from it at every poll, and fall back to the settings only when no live figure is available
